result.question: Why did Uzziah live separately until death?

readings.support: So King Uzziah was a leper until the day of his death. He lived in isolation

readings.answer: Because the LORD had afflicted him.
readings.support: because the LORD had afflicted him.

assessments.reason: Verse 26:21 states, “So King Uzziah was a leper until the day of his death. He lived in isolation,” directly linking his isolation to being a leper.
Verse 26:20 says “because the LORD had afflicted him,” and the context shows the affliction was leprosy, which led to his isolation; this is a broader causal phrasing of the same reason.
